release.item: Added the Compasso continuous recommendation engine with infinite queue flow, real-time session affinity, 1-in-5 artist diversity window, and ATV studio audio purity filtering
Added Familiar, 70/30, and Explore discovery modes in the queue panel with instant upcoming queue adaptation
Refined album and playlist detail screens with dynamic artwork palette headers, centered play controls, and downloaded confirmation badges
Fixed overlapping queue items during batch updates and updated privacy policy settings copy to Verso across all 40 languages
Updated app identity with the final ver/so icon across launcher, Material You themed icon, onboarding, About, Stats, Recap, and Share Cards
Redesigned Home with an editorial magazine layout featuring Featured hero, Pick up again, New releases, Essentials, numbered Trending chart, Explore by mood, and pull-to-refresh
Added dedicated See All and Explore by mood screens with full in-app language support
Improved music recommendations and musically coherent auto-queue for YouTube tracks
Redesigned Downloads with an instant Collections grid and a virtualized Songs tab with A–Z, Album, and Artist filters
Redesigned Favorites and consolidated Favorites and Downloads exclusively inside Library
Replaced character-splitting lyrics highlighting with a flicker-free smooth sweep and progressive focal blur
Improved YouTube Music watch history syncing reliability and updated the Verso privacy policy
Rebranded to Verso with a new Option 1 adaptive icon and redesigned About screen
Added YouTube Music streaming, account login, synced favorites, library browsing, and Activity Mix on Home
Added fast chunked offline downloads with offline playback for downloaded albums and playlists
Added BetterLyrics word-by-word synced lyrics with customizable provider priority and LRCLIB fallback
Added Last.fm integration with automatic 30-second scrobbling and genre discovery
Added Last.fm-style listening stats in Library and a shareable Verso Recap story experience
Redesigned the Now Playing player, floating minimal navigation capsule, and album/playlist views
Added audio quality controls and music cache/download management in Settings
UI tweaks in equalizer, lyrics and tag editing screen
Added basic tablet layout support in horizontal orientation
Added support for the app to work on Huawei devices with Kirin CPUs
